choose.otherwise: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case WHERE rental_order_id=#{id} AND case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report WHERE rental_order_id=#{id} AND issue_status IN ('submitted','processing','waiting_evidence')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim WHERE rental_order_id=#{id} AND claim_status NOT IN ('draft','withdrawn','closed','rejected'))

mapper.sql: SELECT r.id,r.business_type,r.business_order_id,r.reviewer_role,r.rating,r.tag_json,r.content, r.review_status AS status,r.created_at,f.reward_status,c.id AS user_coupon_id FROM order_review r LEFT JOIN coupon_reward_record f ON f.event_type='first_rental_review' AND f.source_id=r.id AND f.user_id=#{actor.userId} AND r.reviewer_user_id=f.user_id LEFT JOIN user_coupon c ON c.issue_request_id=CONCAT('reward:',f.id)
